summary.text: Steven Jacob, a Libertarian who described himself as a 55-year-old retiree, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Kansas's 1st Congressional District to Tracey Mann.
Little other biographical information is publicly available.

paragraphs.text: Jacob graduated from Lawrence High School, according to Ballotpedia, which lists his profession as retired.
He says both parties spend without limit.
During the campaign, he ran on reducing federal spending and the national debt and ending U.S. involvement in foreign wars.
He received 2.7% of the vote to Tracey Mann's 59.4%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
